newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $2, $200 mark beckons for May swap.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $2, $200 mark beckons for May swap.

text.p: NWE gasoline gained nearly $2 a tonne on Tuesday after clambering some $4 higher on Monday.
"The market has certainly picked up on the states but its only two days and I dont see it lasting," said a broker.
Rotterdam barges traded at $195 and $195.50 for prompt to early May loadings while any May swaps traded at $199 and $199.50.
Cargoes were quiet with demand from the United States muted, said dealers. Further forward the market was $3.75 a tonne lower for June and a further $3.75 lower for July.
